literal_meaning: মনের মধ্যে মনের মধ্যে (in the mind, in the mind)
figurative_meaning_bn: নিজের মনের মধ্যে; অন্যের অজ্ঞাতে; কল্পনায়
figurative_meaning_en: Within one's own mind; secretly or unknown to others; in imagination
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে মনে মনে খুব খুশি হলো।
মনে মনে সে সবাইকে অভিনন্দন জানালো।
example_sentences_in_english: He felt very happy to himself.
He congratulated everyone in his mind.
note: This idiom is widely used in Bengali literature to express unspoken thoughts or feelings.
